name: electron-shadcn
summary: Electron desktop app starter pre-configured with React, shadcn/ui, Tailwind, TanStack Router, testing and packaging.
description: A ready-to-use Electron template: Electron 43 + Vite 8 + React 19 + Tailwind 4.3 + shadcn/ui with TanStack Router file-based routing, i18next, Lucide icons, oRPC, Zod and React Query. Ships with Vitest, Playwright, React Testing Library, Electron Forge packaging, auto-update via GitHub Releases and GitHub Actions CI.
contains: shadcn/ui with Tailwind 4.3, Geist font, Lucide icons, i18next
Vitest, Playwright and React Testing Library set up
Electron Forge packaging with auto-update via GitHub Releases
